items.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.description: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.

items.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.description: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.

items.title: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
items.description: Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are all sending delegation to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

items.title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
items.description: A woman says an agency boss sent her to photoshoots at the sex offender's Florida beach home.

items.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
items.description: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

items.title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
items.description: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process next year.

items.title: Qantas to outsource 850 local jobs with most roles moving to India
items.description: The Australian airline said the move was aimed at modernising its IT systems and noted the impact of AI.

items.title: Russia's leading independent newspaper closes after eviction
items.description: The outlet has been evicted from its offices of three decades and says it's been blocked from receiving donations.

items.title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
items.description: Eyewitnesses say the explosion shook the ground, with one believing an earthquake had hit near the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.

items.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case
items.description: The ruling means the case can move forward, possibly with reduced charges in a new trial.

items.title: Trial date of alleged Charlie Kirk killer set for June 2028
items.description: Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder and six other charges in connection with the 2025 killing of the conservative activist.

items.title: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
items.description: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.
